beats.a: Here's a different agent: an on-call assistant. Let's read its code.
beats.b: Its tools call services directly. One checks a status page, one opens incidents, one reads an internal metrics server.

beats.a: One command turns that code into a network policy.
beats.b: No guesswork. Trustabl reads exactly which hosts the agent reaches, and how.

The status check can only read its one status page. The incident tool can only post to its one endpoint. The internal server is listed separately, flagged for a human to review. Everything else is denied.
